reviewer.reason: Runtime-relevant in the shipped desktop asar; js-yaml.load runs on the HTTPS update feed 10 s after every packaged launch; availability-only impact; semver-patch fix 4.3.2 exists so FIXED is achievable without a major; ACCEPTED_RISK is a defensible human alternative (first-party feed) but must be recorded by the release owner.

express is required by the backend bundle and its default extended query parser runs qs.parse on every unauthenticated request before any rate limiter; moderate availability-only advisories; no complete non-major fix (express pins qs ~6.15.1; express 5 is major); partial non-major fix body-parser 1.20.8 and S132 Option A override exist. ACCEPTED_RISK with recorded mitigations is the alternative; decision is the release owner's. Note the production backend is currently not deployed (api host HTTP 530 per 002/32).

Absent from the desktop asar and backend bundle; imported only by apps/web, which no workflow or deploy file publishes, has no SSR, and has only literal navigation targets. Becomes OPEN (fix 7.18.3 is semver-major) if apps/web is ever deployed.
